Pool water bags are easy to use. Bags filled easily and seemed to work, providing weight for pool cover around the pool. My expectation is for the bags to last at least one winter season. In the past, bags always needed to be replaced every one to two years due to water leakages caused by hard winters and by thirsty squirrels chewing into the bags for water. We'll see if these new water bags will last more than one winter season.
